algorithm.name: Forest incumbent with guarded contiguous fifth-core selection
algorithm.method: One fixed, case-ID-independent solver: run the frozen Forest candidate policy; only for five cores attempt one deterministic structurally guarded contiguous fifth-core plan; official P3 must strictly improve, then paired official P2 must be nonworse and exact cross-multiplied G nonworse. All construction, bounds and online evaluations are included in each cold process. Unsupported structures, duplicate proposals, bound-pruned proposals, non-improving P3, or failed paired gate keep the Forest incumbent.

parameters.selection_rule: fresh Forest candidate selection; for K5 only, add deterministic structural contiguous fifth-core proposal; accept only strict P3 M3 improvement and paired P2 M2 nonworse plus exact rational G nonworse
parameters.p2_condition: only after a strict P3 improvement; compare incumbent and candidate under same graph/config/core/plan identity

offline_costs: Static constructor development and pure policy tests occurred before this proposed run; no official E0 calls are charged to this fixed full500 source in this offline preparation. No training, graph-specific scored lookup, or parameter sweep. Prior solver versions/results are not substituted; they are comparison context only.
